in_marathi.name: Lakshraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fortune, Wealth, Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Laksh' which means 'goal' or 'objective'. The name signifies the attainment of wealth, prosperity, and fortune. In Hindu mythology, the god Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth and prosperity.
